import sys
import random

seed = int(sys.stdin.readline())
r = random.Random(seed)
n = r.randint(1, 12)
ops = []
for _ in range(n):
    if r.random() < 0.55:
        ops.append("1 %d" % r.randint(1, 20))
    else:
        ops.append("2")
if "2" not in ops:
    ops.append("2")
print(len(ops))
print("\n".join(ops))
